verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline on one line, so it reads cleanly, and it has an even gap above the CTA. However, the headline runs almost edge to edge with only about 28px of side margin, and the bottom third is mostly dead space with just the olive circle. B has the same layout, but it wraps the headline and leaves 'fizz' alone on its second line. That pushes the headline up against the 'Find a Store' button with almost no gap, while a large empty area remains below the button.
